config.loss: original filtered in-batch Softmax tau1 with the SAME locked frequency score; relation constant under freeze omitted
config.selection: best Dev NDCG@5 per arm, earliest on tie; epoch0 included
config.continuation: conditional must improve BOTH domains by >=.001 N5 and beat matched MLP; conditional paired CI inspected

architecture.global_weights: softmax learned K constants, initialized log mean Train weights
architecture.conditional: softmax(original frozen logits + Linear128to32-GELU-Linear32to1 shared over heads); inputs [LayerNorm(Vk), frozen history mean+last context]; final layer zero
architecture.user_mlp: u + Linear64to32(no bias)-GELU-Linear32to64; input LayerNorm(u); final layer zero; both 4160 parameters
